name: Tasks
description: Generate actionable task lists from implementation plans using the Spec Kit task generation capabilities. This task creates detailed, assignable tasks with dependencies and acceptance criteria.
author: Spec Kit Team

inputs.name: planPath
inputs.label: Plan Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the implementation plans directory. Defaults to $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/plans.

inputs.name: planFile
inputs.label: Plan File
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the plan file to process. Defaults to plan.md.

inputs.name: aiAssistant
inputs.label: AI Assistant
inputs.helpMarkDown: AI assistant to use for task generation.

inputs.name: createWorkItems
inputs.label: Create Work Items
inputs.helpMarkDown: Create work items in Azure DevOps for each generated task.

inputs.name: assignToTeam
inputs.label: Assign to Team
inputs.helpMarkDown: Assign generated tasks to team members.

inputs.name: outputPath
inputs.label: Output Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path where the generated tasks will be saved. Defaults to $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tasks.
